name: st-fusion-steam
setup: bend.set('camera', { followDist: 4.4, followFov: 46, followPitch: 0.1, followSwing: 0 }); bend.wake(); bend.place(0,-0.45,0,Math.PI/2); bend.place(1,0.45,0,-Math.PI/2);
each: const F = bend.show.kinds.find((k) => k.id === 'field').field; F.fuse({ dancers: [0, 1], kind: 'steam', amount: Math.min(1, t/1.2), strength: 2.5, tightness: 1.1 });
